_doc: Per-topic variant schemas. Field types: enum (one value), multi (list of values), int (number or null), bool3 (tak/nie/nie_wynika). Every enum has 'nie_wynika' (not stated in the excerpt). Each answer carries a verbatim quote checked in code. 'keywords': AND of OR-groups of regexes, used to find articles in constitutions where CCP did not tag the topic. Optional 'hints' per field: longer value descriptions used in the model prompt instead of the short UI labels in 'values'. Optional 'tag_first': in wide excerpts, CCP-tagged articles take the size budget before keyword-only articles.

hints.ziemia_rolna_ograniczenia: Szczególne ograniczenia obrotu ziemią rolną lub lasami (np. tylko dla rolników lub obywateli, odesłanie do ustawy szczególnej)

hints.inne: Inne ograniczenie SPRZEDAŻY lub NABYCIA ziemi (np. limit powierzchni, limit drugich domów). Nie: wywłaszczenie, uspołecznienie, reforma rolna bez ograniczenia obrotu

szef_rzadu.odrebny_premier: There is a separate head of government (prime minister, chancellor, premier, president of the council of ministers) distinct from the head of state
szef_rzadu.glowa_panstwa: The head of state (president/monarch) is also head of the government or directs the cabinet; no separate prime minister, or the PM is only a coordinator subordinate to the president

kto_wskazuje.glowa_panstwa: Head of state nominates, designates or appoints the head of government (including after consultations or from the largest party)
kto_wskazuje.parlament: Parliament or one of its chambers elects or proposes the head of government
kto_wskazuje.inne: Other actor (e.g. directly elected, party leader by law, royal council)

inwestytura.uprzednia: Parliament elects or must approve the candidate BEFORE appointment
inwestytura.nastepcza: After appointment the government/PM must obtain a vote of confidence (programme approval) within a deadline
inwestytura.brak: Text indicates appointment without any parliamentary vote

prog_inwestytury.bezwzgledna: Absolute majority of members (majority of the statutory number)

skutek_porazki.wybor_przez_parlament: If the nominee fails, parliament elects its own candidate
skutek_porazki.glowa_panstwa_ponownie: Head of state nominates again or appoints another candidate
skutek_porazki.rozwiazanie_parlamentu: Repeated failure leads (may or must) to dissolution of parliament

kto_odwoluje.parlament: The (first/lower or only) chamber can remove the government/head of government by a no-confidence or censure vote
kto_odwoluje.druga_izba: The second chamber (senate) can ALSO remove the government by its own vote
kto_odwoluje.glowa_panstwa: The head of state can dismiss the head of government or the government on his/her own decision (not just formally after a parliamentary vote or resignation)

druga_izba_weto.label: Siła drugiej izby wobec ustaw zwykłych

values.bezwzgledne: Weto bezwzględne (obie izby muszą się zgodzić)
values.zawieszajace: Weto zawieszające (izba pierwsza może je odrzucić)

values.weto: Może odmówić podpisu lub zwrócić ustawę

druga_izba_weto.bezwzgledne: A bill cannot become law without the agreement of both chambers (disagreement goes to a joint committee whose result both must accept, or the bill fails)
druga_izba_weto.zawieszajace: The second chamber can object or amend, but the first chamber can override it (by any majority) or the bill passes after a delay
druga_izba_weto.tylko_niektore: Second chamber has absolute veto only for specified categories (e.g. consent laws, federal/regional matters) and suspensive for others
druga_izba_weto.brak: Second chamber has no power to block or delay ordinary bills

prog_przelamania.nie_dotyczy: Unicameral, or second chamber veto is absolute / absent

glowa_panstwa_ustawy.weto: Head of state may refuse assent, veto, or return the bill for reconsideration
glowa_panstwa_ustawy.tylko_sad: Head of state cannot veto but may refer the bill to the constitutional court
glowa_panstwa_ustawy.formalny_podpis: Head of state must sign/promulgate; no veto or referral mentioned

ograniczenie_poprawek_finansowych.label: Parlament nie może zwiększać wydatków lub zmniejszać dochodów bez zgody rządu

kto_ma.inne_organy: Courts, regional bodies, prosecutor, other state organs
kto_ma.glowa_panstwa: Head of state can introduce bills (in systems where the HoS is also HoG mark both if text says so)

wylaczna_inicjatywa_rzadu.budzet: Only the government/executive may introduce the budget bill
wylaczna_inicjatywa_rzadu.finanse_podatki: Only the executive may introduce tax, spending or other money bills
wylaczna_inicjatywa_rzadu.inne: Other matters reserved to executive initiative

budget.title: Budżet: kto przygotowuje i co, gdy nie zostanie uchwalony

skutek_nieuchwalenia.prowizorium: Expenditure continues on the basis of the previous budget, monthly twelfths, or a provisional budget
skutek_nieuchwalenia.projekt_wchodzi: The executive's draft enters into force or is enacted by decree/ordinance
skutek_nieuchwalenia.rozwiazanie_parlamentu: Failure to pass the budget allows or requires dissolution of parliament

values.dziala_na_wniosek: Działa na wniosek lub radę rządu

prerogatywy.label: Uprawnienia wykonywane samodzielnie (bez kontrasygnaty lub wniosku rządu)

kontrasygnata.z_wyjatkami: Acts of the head of state require countersignature by the PM/minister, except listed prerogatives
kontrasygnata.ogolna: All acts require countersignature, no exceptions listed
kontrasygnata.dziala_na_wniosek: Head of state acts on the advice or proposal of the government/PM (Westminster-type 'acts on advice')
kontrasygnata.brak: Head of state is the chief executive and acts on own authority; no countersignature rule
